verdict: Yes. Perfora pitched toothpaste and electric toothbrushes on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from three sharks. Oral care is dominated by a few brands, but buyers are open to modern, design-led products, and refills create recurring revenue.
angle: Electric toothbrushes, natural toothpastes and mouthwashes appeal to buyers looking for better oral care. Subscriptions for brush heads and toothpaste build steady revenue. Dentists are influential.
